projectTitle: Executive LinkedIn Ghostwriting Campaign & System Build
projectScenario: You have been hired as the lead ghostwriter for the CEO of a fast-growing B2B technology company. The CEO has 15,000 LinkedIn followers but hasn't posted in 3 months due to lack of time. They require a fully automated AI-assisted ghostwriting workflow and a 4-week thought leadership campaign (12 posts) that establishes authority, drives qualified inbound leads, and sounds unmistakably like them.
deliverables: Executive Voice Matrix & Tonality Dossier (sentence structure, banned words, signature hooks, 3 target audience avatars).
System Prompts Architecture Document (full system prompts for Research Agent, Drafter Agent, and Critic Agent).
Workflow Architecture Diagram showing trigger, AI nodes, feedback loop, and approval interface.
12 Ready-to-Publish LinkedIn Posts organized into 4 content pillars (Founder Story, Industry Contrarian, Tactical Framework, Case Study Breakdown).
Monthly Content Calendar with optimal publishing times, hook variations, and asset tags.
Client Approval & Feedback SOP document outlining the weekly review process.
One-page quality assurance and anti-AI verification report.
whoFor: Freelance writers and copywriters transitioning into high-ticket executive ghostwriting.
Content marketers and agency operators looking to scale LinkedIn content production without sacrificing authenticity.
Founders and executives who want to build an internal AI-assisted personal branding engine.
Learners who want to master no-code AI agent workflows and voice replication frameworks.
outcomes: A configured multi-agent LinkedIn ghostwriting architecture with research, drafting, and feedback nodes.
A comprehensive Executive Voice Dossier and tonality rulebook for a target founder.
A 4-week, 12-post thought leadership campaign ready for client delivery.
An automated Slack/chat review interface for real-time post iterations.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of LinkedIn content dynamics, prompt engineering fundamentals, and familiarity with no-code tools.
keyTerms: Voice Vectoring
The practice of codifying a founder's vocabulary, sentence length, rhetorical devices, and contrarian perspectives into repeatable system prompts.
Hook Retain Rate
The percentage of LinkedIn readers who click 'see more' on the first three lines of a post.
Trojan Horse Post
A post that leads with an engaging personal narrative or case study and embeds strategic business positioning.
Multi-Agent Swarm
A network of specialized AI sub-agents (Researcher, Drafter, Critic) working sequentially to refine content.
Information Gain
The unique, non-commodity value and proprietary data present in a piece of content compared to existing web results.
Anti-AI Heuristics
Editorial rules specifically designed to eliminate generic AI phrases, robotic cadence, and excessive adjectives.

lessons.title: Introduction to AI Ghostwriting & Architecture
lessons.notes: Explores the fundamental shift from manual freelance writing to AI-augmented ghostwriting. The lesson deconstructs why single-prompt LLM generation produces generic, easily detectable LinkedIn content. It introduces the multi-agent paradigm: decoupling information gathering, draft synthesis, and voice tuning into distinct computational steps to preserve founder authenticity.
lessons.activity: Map out a 3-agent ghostwriting workflow on paper or digital canvas (Researcher -> Drafter -> Critic) and identify the specific inputs required at each stage.
lessons.reflection: Why do single-prompt LinkedIn posts almost always sound like generic marketing copy, and how does multi-agent separation solve this?

lessons.title: Live Ghostwriting Agent Demonstration & Output Inspection
lessons.notes: Demonstrates a functioning ghostwriting agent running live. Analyzes the differences between raw LLM output and agentic output conditioned on specific founder voice parameters. The lesson highlights key evaluation criteria: hook strength, line spacing, conversational rhythm, story-to-insight ratio, and call-to-conversation endings.
lessons.activity: Take a sample generic AI-generated LinkedIn post and manually annotate every instance of generic phrasing, passive voice, or artificial buzzwords.
lessons.reflection: What are the three most noticeable 'AI tells' on LinkedIn, and what specific rules can prevent them?

lessons.title: Building the Topic & Industry Research Agent
lessons.notes: Step-by-step build of the Research Agent. Covers scraping niche newsletters, parsing RSS feeds, extracting trending news from industry portals, and identifying content gaps. Shows how to engineer system instructions that force the agent to extract specific data points, contrarian angles, and actionable case studies rather than surface-level summaries.
lessons.activity: Build and test the system prompt for a Research Agent targeting a specific industry (e.g., B2B SaaS or FinTech) and verify that it outputs 5 concrete story angles.
lessons.reflection: How does providing primary research data improve the Information Gain score of an AI-assisted post?

lessons.title: Configuring the Copywriting & Tone-Feedback Agent
lessons.notes: Focuses on the core drafting and feedback loops. Implements the Executive Voice Matrix: sentence length distribution, vocabulary constraints, preferred hook templates (e.g., 'Contrarian Take', 'Behind-the-Scenes Breakdown', 'Hard Truth'), and paragraph structures. Integrates a Critic Agent that scores drafts against brand guidelines before human review.
lessons.activity: Configure a Critic Agent prompt that scores drafts from 1-10 on Voice Match, Hook Punchiness, and Jargon Absence, with mandatory rewrite suggestions.
lessons.reflection: Why is a dedicated critique step more reliable than asking the drafter agent to 'check its own work' in a single prompt?

lessons.title: Creating a Slack Assistant for Instant AI Drafting & Editing

Demonstrates how a ghostwriter or founder can drop a 30-second voice note, rough bullet points, or an article link into Slack and receive three polished, tone-aligned LinkedIn drafts within seconds, complete with revision options.
lessons.activity: Configure a webhook or test harness that accepts a raw bullet-point input and returns two formatted LinkedIn draft variations.
lessons.reflection: How does lowering the friction of capturing founder thoughts in real time increase the quality of ghostwritten content?

lessons.title: Advanced Workflow Optimization, Quality Control & Client Delivery
lessons.notes: Covers production operations, client onboarding, batch scheduling, and continuous feedback loops. Teaches how to conduct a 45-minute monthly interview that fuels an entire month of content, how to present drafts in a client-friendly approval portal, and how to track engagement metrics to refine the agent prompts over time.
lessons.activity: Draft a complete Client Onboarding Voice Questionnaire containing 10 deep-dive extraction questions designed to uncover personal stories and contrarian views.
lessons.reflection: What role does human editorial judgement play when AI handles 80% of the initial research and drafting workload?

AI algorithms that separate high-frequency skin texture (pores, hairs) from low-frequency color/tone to smooth transitions without blurring.

Micro-Texture Preservation
Maintaining genuine dermal pores and surface details rather than creating artificial 'plastic' skin.
Specular Highlight Glare

An editing pipeline where all AI adjustments live on independent layers, allowing infinite revisions without damaging original pixels.

keyTerms: Autonomous AI Agent
A computational system that uses an LLM as its reasoning engine to perceive an environment, plan actions, invoke tools, and achieve user-defined goals without step-by-step human intervention.
ReAct Framework (Reason + Act)
A prompting paradigm where the model explicitly generates reasoning traces ('Thought') followed by discrete actions ('Action: Tool[Input]') and observations ('Observation').
Function Calling / Tool Binding
A structured API capability where the LLM outputs a JSON object specifying the name of a function and its exact arguments to be executed by the host runtime.
Recursion Limit / Loop Guardrail
A hard safety constraint that limits the maximum number of consecutive tool executions to prevent infinite execution loops.
Context Window Pruning
Dynamically summarizing or dropping older conversation turns to keep agent memory within model context token limits.
Agentic Reflection / Self-Correction
A secondary prompting step where the agent reviews its own output against criteria before returning a final answer.

keyTerms: Context Engineering
The deliberate architecture and management of all information, metadata, system rules, and few-shot examples fed into an LLM's context window.
